runtime_audit.blocking_reason: The real-only cohort has replay artifacts, but action-specific adapters remain incomplete and the planner runtime still reveals hidden claims in simulation.

planner_decision_count.definition: Count each planner output accepted at a decision boundary; a selected STOP is one planner decision.

execution_attempt_count.definition: Count every dispatched acquisition execution separately, including failed, cancelled, and retried attempts.

primitive_operation_count.definition: Count operations at the collector-defined primitive boundary; never infer one primitive from one planner action.

split_merge_invariance.rule: Equivalent work must conserve raw resource totals when a planner action is split or merged; only the declared count level may change.
